selected_work: R93 reusable diagnostic fixed-function vertex-shader prototype for Set 05 F21.
summary: Added a reusable R93 vertex-shader source prototype to pipeline_translation for the narrow fixed-function FVF subset XYZ + optional DIFFUSE + up to eight 1D-4D texture coordinates. The prototype models a D3D11 b0 row-major WVP constant-buffer contract and matching COLOR0/TEXCOORD outputs. XYZRHW, blend weights/indices, NORMAL/lighting, PSIZE and SPECULAR fail closed. The existing R92 linkage probe now compiles and reflects the generated R93 VS instead of a hardcoded compatible shader.
